Title: A couple of questions about Immortal Grapple

Messages.Author: mark.towers
Messages.Body:
Immortal Grapple states "Only hand strikes may be used in this combat". Does
this mean this round of combat only or the entire combat ?

Also, are Thaumaturgy strikes considered to be hand strikes, or are they
considered to be magical strikes and therefore unusable when Immortal
Grapple is played ?

Mark.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In article <387e6...@news2.vip.uk.com>, mark.towers
<mark....@breathemail.net> writes

>Immortal Grapple states "Only hand strikes may be used in this combat". Does
>this mean this round of combat only or the entire combat ?
>

By current rulings (check the errata etc.) this round only.

>Also, are Thaumaturgy strikes considered to be hand strikes, or are they
>considered to be magical strikes and therefore unusable when Immortal
>Grapple is played ?

They are not hand strikes.

Anything which isn't based on hand damage isn't a hand strike. Melee
weapons, despite being based on hand damage, are also not hand strikes.
So Scorpion Sting is a hand strike, Undead Strength is a hand strike,
but Theft of Vitae is not, nor is Body of Sun or Meat Cleaver.

--
